title: T47 item 5: CI runs swarm check-pins; agent-core range pin
head: t47-check-pins
body:
## Summary

T47 item 5 (decisions #223–#225) plus the #222 forward-port.

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: new ubuntu-only `internal pins` job runs `swarm check-pins` from project-swarm at the pinned tag `v1.25.0`. The existing `check` job is unchanged.
- `pyproject.toml`: `agent-core==0.7.22` → `agent-core>=0.7.22,<0.8`. A library never exact-pins agent-core, the host it loads into (R1). `[tool.uv.sources]` still points at the vendored 0.7.22 wheel, so the resolved version and `uv.lock` are unchanged (`uv lock --check --offline` passes; path sources record no specifier).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: two Unreleased entries. No version bump, no code change.

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

The gate is the new CI job. Before this PR, `main` (727fb68) fails `check-pins` with `library-exact-core-pin: skills pins agent-core with == (0.7.22)`, exit 1. With the range, `check-pins: ok`. So putting the exact pin back makes the new job fail.
